name: mastra-easy-day-js-self-deleting-dropper
note: modeled on the easy-day-js dropper used in the Mastra AI compromise (June 2026, Sapphire Sleet): an obfuscated postinstall fetches a second stage, executes it, then unlinks its own file so the installed tree looks clean. No CVE was ever assigned — there is nothing for a CVE-based scanner to match on.
